rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality advanced blastocyst with compact ICM and cohesive TE consistent with 4AA, and appropriately notes uncertainty about visible hatching on a single static image. Minor limitation: relies partly on reported grade rather than image-only detail.

Integrates age, AMH/low oocyte yield, PCOS, endometrial thickness, BMI/lifestyle, prior cycle history, and semen parameters into prognosis well. Slight overstatement/confusion in linking low reserve as 'typical of PCOS' prevents a top score.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent: strong morphology and lining balanced against age-related aneuploidy and limited cohort size. Minor issues include a likely typo about 'only one MII' despite data showing 3 MII and some imprecision around implantation vs clinical pregnancy/live birth terminology.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based: single embryo transfer, standard luteal support, no bed rest, caution about add-ons, individualized PGT-A discussion. Small deviations include speculative comments about PCOS/low reserve and donor oocyte discussion being somewhat premature after a first cycle.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, routine support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and considering cumulative family-building strategy. Useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain general rather than protocol-specific.
